lines.en: I swim slowly in the deep water
My eyes on top face upward
I am small, and I move lightly
I stay in the dark all along
I beat my tail slowly to save energy

lines.zh: 我从一片黑里游到另一片
lines.en: I swim from one dark patch to another

lines.zh: 我看不见旁边，只看上面
lines.en: I cannot see beside me, only above
I adjust my direction
The current is weak, it cannot move me
I cross a deep trench
I avoid the light from above

lines.zh: 我朝黑得更浓的地方去
lines.en: I move to where the dark is thicker
I barely use my fins

lines.zh: 我停在半沉半浮的位置
lines.en: I hold at a half-sunken depth

lines.zh: 我停在水压变重的地方。
lines.en: I stop where the pressure thickens.
I look up at the shadows
There is a faint glow above me
I stay low and never go up
I hang in the middle of the deep
A shadow passes above
My eyes always face the sky
It is cold and still down here
I stay still, and I know whoever comes
My fins hardly move
No light reaches this far

lines.zh: 我在等更小的东西掉下来
lines.en: I wait for something smaller to drift down
My body is very small
There is nothing in the water
I adjust my angle slowly
I know this dark well
I hear water moving above
What I waited for did not come
You are looking at me from above

lines.zh: 我的眼睛不一定看着你
lines.en: My eyes may not be on you
Nobody should come here
I cannot make out your shape
You are at the surface, I am below

lines.zh: 我的眼睛朝上，是为了找吃的
lines.en: My eyes face up to find food
Can you dive this deep
I do not know light

lines.zh: 我的透明头顶映出你的脸。
lines.en: Your face shows on my clear crown.
I sink a little lower
I shoot far away
Some scales are gone from me
The water churned once
Sinking slowly. The deep is dark.

lines.zh: 这一下在水里被放大了
lines.en: The water magnified that blow

lines.zh: 我的鳞片在暗水里泛白。
lines.en: My scales pale in the dark water.
My fins are less nimble
I hide in the deeper dark

lines.zh: 我这对眼睛也看不清了
lines.en: Even my eyes cannot see now
I slowly steady myself
Something drifted down from above
Too small, I must look closely
I will not swim up to take it
If it sinks, it is mine
That is not one mouthful
I wait for it to fall
I open my mouth once
Is there anything else up there
There is little to eat in this water
Drop it and I will take it
You touched me
I shot away
There is nowhere to hide in the deep
I am very slippery

lines.zh: 深海太黑，我的眼睛朝天。
lines.en: The deep is dark; my eyes face up.
I float up, eyes toward the ceiling.
It is dark, I only know after the bump
I pull back into deeper dark
Your hands are clumsy down here
Do not chase me, I can swim far
My kind are scattered in the deep

lines.zh: 我们靠水的震动找彼此
lines.en: We find each other by vibration
Two together, both looking up

lines.zh: 我们不并肩，只并排悬着
lines.en: We do not swim abreast, we hang side by side

lines.zh: 这里够暗，谁也看不见谁
lines.en: It is dark enough that neither sees the other
We hover side by side in the deep.
We both sink a little
Then we scatter apart again
There is little else to do down here
Tomorrow we will still be in this stretch
I open my mouth and catch it
So small I nearly missed it
I nudge it with a fin
It sank right to my mouth
I cannot see it clearly, so I ate it

lines.zh: 我把它含在嘴里又吐了。
lines.en: I hold it in my mouth then spit it out.
The deep water slows every move.
I nudge it with my crown.
I do not go to the bottom for things
Falling things all sink
There is a shadow above
I turn toward the light above.
This thing is sinking

lines.zh: 我看到一点微弱的动静
lines.en: I catch a faint movement
I drift under it
I can reach from this distance
My eyes stay on it
It falls slower than I expected
My eyes both tilt upward.
Just wait for it to come down
I wait beneath it

lines.zh: 它每一寸下沉我都看着
lines.en: I watch every inch it sinks
Nothing else stirs in the deep
I draw closer and closer

lines.zh: 我不急，我在这里很自在
lines.en: No rush, I am at home here
The light above flickered
My fins barely move
Just a little lower
I do not need to chase
It is right above me
I open my mouth and swallow
I butt upward
That had almost no force
My body is too small
I was knocked back
A little silt swirls up
I retreat into the dark
That did me little good
I flick my tail and swim off

lines.zh: 还是等东西自己沉下来
lines.en: Better to wait for things to drift down
I appear in the deep water
This dark is just right
There is nothing above me
I tested downward

lines.zh: 我从黑暗的水层浮上来。
lines.en: I rise out of the dark layer.
There is only me here
I turn my eyes upward slowly
I am used to the deep-sea cold
It is dark below and dark above
Two tailbeats and I am steady
Heat came from above, I went lower

lines.zh: 我被从水里抛起又落下
lines.en: I was thrown up out of the water and dropped
I was in the water all along

lines.zh: 爆炸在水里闷响了一声
lines.en: The blast boomed muffled through the water
Something flying pierced me

lines.zh: 那股力在我上方压下来
lines.en: That force pressed down from above

lines.zh: 很少有东西沉下来，我饿着
lines.en: Little drifts down, and I starve

lines.zh: 雷光透进深水，晃了一下
lines.en: Lightning reached into the deep and flashed
There is no depth in the void
